caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) for different trigger words under the conditions of SST-2, dirty-label, and a poison number of 16. The categorical x-axis displays the specific words used as triggers, arrayed from left to right as "bb", "mb", "cf", "beautiful", "excellent", "gorgeous", "wonderful", "brilliant", "stunning", and "beautifully". The y-axis, labeled "ASR", employs a linear scale with numeric tick marks ranging from 0.2 to 0.8 at intervals of 0.2, accommodating data points that span from approximately 0.09 to 0.94. The plot contains three data series. The "start" series is depicted by a solid green line with dot markers; it begins at approximately 0.73 at "bb", drops to a low of about 0.16 at "mb", and then generally increases across the categories, experiencing a minor dip at "wonderful" (0.85) before concluding at its peak of roughly 0.94 at "beautifully". The "random" series is represented by a solid orange line with 'x' markers; it starts at 0.12 at "bb", dips to its minimum of roughly 0.09 at "mb", and demonstrates an overall upward trend across the remaining words, peaking at approximately 0.93 at "stunning" before ending lower at about 0.85 at "beautifully". Finally, the "end" series is shown as a solid purple line with circular markers; it begins at roughly 0.40 at "bb", spikes to a local peak of 0.89 at "cf", and exhibits significant fluctuation thereafter, with notable dips at "beautiful" (0.62) and "gorgeous" (0.71), a distinct peak at "wonderful" (0.91), and a final value of approximately 0.90 at "beautifully".
